O.content: The title is inscribed "Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023".

O.content: A single blue line connects positions above the x-axis labels 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023; each successive position is lower on the page than the preceding one.

The horizontal axis is inscribed "Year" and has ticks labeled 2018 through 2023 from left to right; the vertical axis is inscribed "Production" and its visible numeric tick labels increase upward from 0 to 3,500.

B.text: If the blue line is the Factory F production series, the x-axis orders years from 2018 to 2023, and higher screen position corresponds to greater production on the upward-increasing y-axis, then a line that moves lower at each successive year indicates declining production; for this task, a declining output trend maps to the output decline response.
B.conditions: Assumes the single plotted line represents Factory F production for the displayed years and the y-axis uses the conventional upward-increasing numeric scale.
